title: Cloud Bread
description: Airy, protein-rich egg-based bread with cream cheese — nearly zero carbs and perfect for sandwiches or snacking.
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C / 350°F. Separate yolks from whites into two bowls.
Mix cream cheese into yolks; add salt and pepper; stir smooth.
Add baking soda and baking powder to whites; beat with hand mixer 1–2 minutes until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold whites into yolk mixture until just combined.
Lay 6 portions on parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake 12–15 minutes until golden. Best with deli meat and mozzarella.
notes: Taste best filled with deli meat and fresh mozzarella.
